proposals.name: Modularity
proposals.span: Modularity divides a system into modules that can be developed and changed separately.

proposals.name: Coupling
proposals.span: Coupling measures how strongly modules depend on each other.

proposals.name: Cohesion
proposals.span: Cohesion measures how closely the elements inside one module belong together.

proposals.name: Information hiding
proposals.span: Information hiding keeps design decisions that are likely to change inside one module.

proposals.name: Class diagram
proposals.span: A class diagram shows the classes of a system and the relationships between them.

proposals.name: Component diagram
proposals.span: A component diagram shows how larger parts of the system are connected through interfaces.

proposals.name: Equivalence partitioning
proposals.span: Equivalence partitioning divides the input domain into classes whose members are expected to behave alike.

proposals.name: Boundary value analysis
proposals.span: Boundary value analysis selects test inputs at the edges of the classes found by equivalence partitioning
